serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.happy
You: Do you see Shanice anywhere?
Bot: No. 
Bot: There’s some commotion at the centre of the rink…
You: Woah…
It’s Shanice, she’s doing some incredible stuff, attracting the attention of almost everyone nearby.
Bot: Did you know she’s this skilled at this?
You: I had no idea. I thought that she was joking when saying that she’s a ‘beast’ on ice.
Bot: I think she should change jobs. Being a professional figure skater is for sure a far more better paying job than working in that rundown church.
You: I agree.
Bot: I think she saw us.
You: Yeah, she’s waving and coming this way.
